title: Premature depletion is not a single mechanism
hypothesis: The same clinical endpoint of premature battery depletion can arise from cell-internal electrochemistry, battery header/feedthrough, battery-to-electronics interconnect, generator electronics current drain, capacitor load, firmware/telemetry, or generator package problems.
primary_outcome: premature depletion phenotype and returned-product finding
required_stratifiers: manufacturer; platform; cell supplier/model; production era; implant age
notes: Never classify premature depletion as battery-cell failure without evidence.

title: Shared cell architecture across generator families
hypothesis: If the same cell supplier/model or materially equivalent cell architecture appears in multiple generator families, similar confirmed cell-internal failure phenotypes may cluster across nominal device brands/platforms.
required_stratifiers: cell production era; generator family; design revisions; advisories
notes: Needs explicit cell identity; do not infer supplier from chemistry alone.

title: Failure phenotype around battery design revisions
hypothesis: Engineering changes to electrode barriers, battery headers, feedthroughs, seals, interconnects or process controls may correspond to changes in the distribution of confirmed failure mechanisms before versus after the revision.
required_stratifiers: manufacture date; implant date; exact model; revision effective date
notes: Regulatory supplement approval date may not equal first/last production date; production boundaries need verification.

title: Cell-normal versus interconnect failure
hypothesis: Cases with normal cell electrochemistry or no cell defect but abnormal terminal pin/post/spring-connector/feedthrough behavior form a distinct battery-system failure class and should not be pooled with internal shorts.
primary_outcome: loss of power; abrupt depletion; inability to interrogate; intermittent supply
required_stratifiers: returned-product analysis; corrosion; connection evidence; manufacturing era
notes: Biotronik battery-terminal-pin corrosion provides a concrete seed phenotype.
